_doc: SkippyCore's model slots. Each slot has a small STAND-IN (the simulator and CI run it) and the FULL model the Bosgame runs. Same slot, same aliases, same API: switching is CORE_FULL=<slots> in /etc/skippy-core/core.env, never a code change. Paths are relative to MODELS_ROOT and follow tools/models_archive.py's layout (huggingface/<Org>__<Repo>/<file>), so the D:\models archive copies over as-is. sha256 null = not pinned yet: core/llm/models.py fetch prints the hash to pin. Sizes are bytes as Hugging Face lists them (2026-10-16; Qwen3.6 2026-10-23). Since 2026-10-23 chat and coder both run Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (the Strix Halo community's pick, won core/bench): chat as Unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL with thinking OFF by default (a request turns it on with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking true), coder as Unsloth's MTP Q8_0 with multi-token prediction (--spec-type draft-mtp: ~1.4x the tokens/s, but llama.cpp allows it only with --parallel 1) and thinking on. The models they replaced stay on disk as candidates. parallel (per variant, default 4) is llama-server's --parallel; max_parallel caps it: stock Vulkan loses about a third of its throughput past 8. The chat stand-in runs with thinking off (enable_thinking false: Qwen3-0.6B otherwise spends its answer thinking) and a 16K context: Skippy's persona prompt alone is about 3.5K tokens. core/README.md.

chat.role: Skippy's default tier, summaries, Mentat's phrasings: always loaded

vision.role: eyes for the text-only slots: describes images and screenshots (the coder's reference pictures, its own page). Always loaded, so it never swaps out the coder

general.role: the big general tier: tools, long answers. Loaded on demand; swaps with coder

coder.role: the coding agent (Claude Code via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: the Workshop's Core brain). RESIDENT (2026-10-24, the Captain's call): an agent turn never waits for a 38 GB load, and its prompt cache (--cache-ram, in host RAM) survives between turns. One request at a time (MTP); Claude Code's background calls go to chat. With it resident, general's full model (gpt-oss-120b) doesn't fit beside it: the planner refuses it

home._doc: skippy-pc's own models: what runs on the PC's NVIDIA card, not in skippy-core's llama-swap slots above. Read this before looking for a model anywhere (Ollama, pip, the disk): if the job is listed here, use the service named and never install another. Only `slots` drive skippy-core (core/llm/models.py reads nothing else); this block is a directory for agents and people.

voice.job: text to speech: Skippy chat's spoken replies
voice.service: tts-studio (services/tts-studio), reached only through voice-gate (services/voice-gate) on tts-net; the portal's pass says which voice

voices.skippy: F5-TTS v1 Base at 16 flow steps, zero-shot from the Captain's ElevenLabs Skippy print: the Captain in Private mode (his default). Resident.
voices.stock: Kokoro-82M, bm_george: everyone else who may chat (Public). Resident.
voices.elevenlabs: the cloud Skippy voice via flask-api: the Captain in Auto mode only, and the fallback while tts-studio is down or busy

voice.how_a_chat_speaks: the page does it: with the chat's speaker key (or Hands-off) on, skippy-voice.js sends each finished reply to voice-gate /tts. No model and no tool call is involved; an agent never renders speech itself.
voice.health: voice-gate /health inside skippytel-voice-gate (port 8080): voices.skippy, voices.stock, voices.elevenlabs

hearing.job: speech to text: the chats' mic
hearing.service: whisper (faster-whisper, WHISPER_MODEL, default medium, CUDA) behind voice-gate /stt

music.job: songs for the chat's make_music tool
music.service: music-studio (ACE-Step 1.5), driven by the home reporter, one GPU job at a time

candidates._doc: Models on trial for a slot, or retired from one ("for"), served beside the slots under their own names with models.py --bench <name> (or BENCH=<name>): on demand, in the coder's swap group. A winner moves into its slot's full; the loser stays here, with its files on disk. Results: core/bench/README.md.
